theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a b c f g
  cases f
  case refl => exact ⟨_, g, .refl _⟩
  case par x y z w fx fz =>
    cases g
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par fx fz⟩
    case par p q gp gq =>
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hu'⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond fx gp
      obtain ⟨v, hv, hv'⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond fz gq
      exact ⟨u ⬝ v, .par hu hv, .par hu' hv'⟩
    case red_I =>
      rw [I_irreducible y fx]
      exact ⟨w, .red_I w, fz⟩
    case red_K =>
      obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible c y fx
      exact ⟨u, .red_K u w, hu⟩
    case red_S r s =>
      obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible r s y fx
      exact ⟨u ⬝ w ⬝ (v ⬝ w), .red_S u v w, .par (.par hu fz) (.par hv fz)⟩
  case red_I =>
    cases g
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I ..⟩
    case par p q hp hq =>
      rw [I_irreducible p hp]
      exact ⟨q, hq, .red_I q⟩
    case red_I => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_K d =>
    cases g
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K ..⟩
    case par p q hp hq =>
      obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible b p hp
      exact ⟨u, hu, .red_K u q⟩
    case red_K => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_S r s t =>
    cases g
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    case par p q hp hq =>
      obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible r s p hp
      exact ⟨u ⬝ q ⬝ (v ⬝ q), .par (.par hu hq) (.par hv hq), .red_S u v q⟩
    case red_S => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
